Anna L.: Heads up — pulling together cost inputs from CoreWeave and other hardware partners for marketplace pricing + our finance model. Need the following by EOD Wed: reserved tiers (1y/3y), spot avg price and preempt rate, lead times, min commit, regional availability, marketplace fee, and billing granularity. @Bob C. can you share rough numbers we can plug into modeling?

Bob C.: Sure — dropping a high-level sketch now, can follow up with a signed CSV. Quick notes: 

Bob C.: ```
on_demand:   $0.69 / GPU-hr
1y_reserved: $0.45 / GPU-hr (≈35% off OD, amortized)
3y_reserved: $0.30 / GPU-hr (≈55% off OD)
spot_avg:    $0.18 / GPU-hr (~73% off OD)
spot_preempt_rate: 12% (region dependent)
lead_time: 2-3 weeks for >100 GPU allocation
min_commit: 8 GPUs for 1yr (flexible for larger deals)
regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1 (capacity varies)
marketplace_fee: 2% on usage
billing: per-minute with 1-minute minimum
```

Mike R.: Can you confirm currency (USD) and whether reserved prices are quoted as upfront or amortized? Also we need a committed $ spend estimate for 12/36 mo to model cashflow.

Bob C.: All USD. Prices above are effective hourly amortized assuming even utilization. If you need upfront list prices we can provide those too. For a conservative modeling baseline assume 75% utilization on reserved pools. Example calc for min commit: 8 GPUs * 24h * 365 * $0.45 ≈ $31,000/yr.

Sophia K.: Preempt rates by region? We need per-hour preempt probabilities for the simulator (histogram or percentiles ideal).

Bob C.: Typical spot preempt by region: us-west-2 10-15%, eu-west-1 8-12%, ap-southeast-1 18-22% during peak. Will export per-hour percentiles and a sample day-of-week heatmap.

Anna L.: :tada: Also for partner marketing/announce planning — are there windows you prefer for joint announcements? We generally need a 2-week embargo after contract signature and a quote + logo. Any blackout dates?

Bob C.: We prefer to avoid announcements during our quarterly close (first 10 days of Apr and Oct). Otherwise we can commit to a co-announce 4 weeks after go-live. We'll add PR terms to the partner addendum.

marketplace-bot: Contract 'CoreWeave - Redwood Marketplace Addendum' uploaded (ID #CW-2026-004) to /contracts.

Anna L.: Perfect. Mike/Sophia — I'll drop Bob's CSV into the modeling sheet and tag you both for any adjustments. Bob — can you send the finalized CSV + standard SOW by EOD tomorrow? Appreciate it.

Bob C.: Will do. Sending initial CSV to anna@redwood-inference.com now — let me know if you need extra fields.

Mike R.: One more ask: include SKU-level breakdown (A100 80GB, A100 40GB, H100, etc.) and whether reserved discounts vary by model. Also include minimum utilization assumptions you used to amortize reserved hourly rates.

Bob C.: Yes — discounts scale by SKU and demand. CSV will include columns: 'sku','region','on_demand','reserved_1y','reserved_3y','spot','preempt_rate','min_commit','billing_unit'.

Anna L.: :thumbsup: thanks everyone — will follow up once the CSV is in the sheet.
